brief: The 6 eval patterns that catch AI regressions before customers do — with thresholds.

slots.body: These six evaluation patterns catch silent AI regressions in staging and production using hard thresholds that block bad releases before users ever feel the pain.
Run a frozen benchmark suite on every model change. If accuracy drops more than two percent, block the release.
slots.card1Body: Model version bumps and fine-tuning validation before production deploys.
slots.card2Body: A 2% accuracy drop on gold data predicts a 10x spike in user complaints.

slots.body: Inject known-answer questions into live traffic. Alert when the success rate falls below ninety-five percent.
slots.card1Body: Catching prompt regressions and config changes in production traffic.
slots.card2Body: Five canaries with 100% historical accuracy expose silent failures instantly.

slots.body: Sample production outputs daily for human review. Flag the pipeline when error rates exceed three percent.
slots.card1Body: Subjective tasks where automated metrics fail to capture true quality.
slots.card2Body: Human spot checks find edge cases that automated tests completely miss.

slots.body: Route ten percent of traffic to the challenger model. Roll back if conversion or accuracy lags the champion.
slots.card1Body: Safe production launches with real user impact validation.
slots.card2Body: A one percent lift in a gold metric beats a hundred percent on a static test.

slots.body: Monitor embedding distance between recent inputs and training distribution. Trigger retraining at KL divergence above zero point one.
slots.card1Body: Detecting when user behavior shifts and model assumptions become stale.
slots.card2Body: Embedding drift precedes accuracy decay by weeks in most language models.

slots.body: Enforce a p99 response time ceiling. If inference exceeds eight hundred milliseconds, degrade gracefully or fallback.
slots.card1Body: User experience protection when model size or load spikes unexpectedly.
slots.card2Body: Latency regressions correlate with timeout errors and user churn directly.

slots.body: Start with one threshold this week. Build the habit before your next model ships to production.
slots.quote: HARD THRESHOLDS CATCH SILENT REGRESSIONS EARLY
